scope: Recorded preparation of the existing image files; no model training settings are included.

collected_source_images.per_image_record: The modifications field in the source records and manifests records the preparation applied to each file.

catalog_fallback_images: Existing catalog references are preserved with their own checksums and kind fields, including scan_render. They are not re-encoded by the audit.

audit.decoded_pixel_integrity: SHA-256 of RGB dimensions and pixel bytes
audit.similarity_limit: A candidate is not proof of duplication or capture independence.

training_augmentation: None in Week 1; any Week 2 transformations must remain inside the training/reference split.
